metadata.question: Did the Jianghan District of Wuhan show lower nightime light intensity on February 4, 2020, compared to January 19, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) data - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" (monthly) or "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VCMSLCFG" (daily) - Need daily data to compare specific dates - Location: Jianghan District, Wuhan, China (approximately 30.59°N, 114.27°E) - Dates: January 19, 2020 vs February 4, 2020 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Quality filtering may be needed based on available QA bands 3. Logic: - Compare mean nighttime light intensity between the two dates - Valid data should be positive numbers - If Feb 4 < Jan 19, answer A (Yes) - If Feb 4 >= Jan 19, answer B (No) - Check for C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Jianghan District, Wuhan geometry (approximate center) const jianghan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.27, 30.59]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // 2. Date definitions const date1 = '2020-01-19'; const date2 = '2020-02-04'; // 3. Try VIIRS Daily DNB data const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(jianghan); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(jianghan); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 19 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Feb 4 Images: ${size2}`); // Check for missing data if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get images and calculate stats const img1 = ee.Image(col1.first()); const img2 = ee.Image(col2.first()); const band = 'avg_rad'; // Average radiance band // Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for both dates const stats1 = img1.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: jianghan, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: jianghan, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 19: Mean=${mean1}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Feb 4: Mean=${mean2}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 5. Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Compare and answer console.log(`Difference: ${(mean2 - mean1).toFixed(4)} (negative means Feb < Jan)`); if (mean2 < mean1) { console.log('Feb 4 shows lower nighttime light intensity than Jan 19'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Feb 4 does not show lower nighttime light intensity than Jan 19'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
